resources.string: It was ended from another device: under Devices in Telegram, or with “It’s not me” on the notice about a new sign-in.
The session expired: it was not used for a long time.
Telegram deleted or blocked this account. @SpamBot can tell you why, or write to recover@telegram.org.
Usual reasons: it was ended from another device, it was not used for a long time, or many identical messages were sent from the account in a short time, which Telegram treats as spam.

If it was not you, someone else may have your account. Sign in again right away, end unknown sessions under Settings → Devices (a device that has just signed in cannot end older ones for up to 24 hours) and turn on two-step verification. Do not tell anyone the code.
The reason has been saved: after signing in you can send it to Humogram with “Send feedback” in Settings.
Telegram has paused sign-in for this number after too many attempts. You can try again in:
A code was requested for this number too many times. Telegram asks you to wait a few hours, sometimes up to a day.
The password was entered wrong too many times. Try again a little later.

If you did not try this many times yourself, someone is trying to sign in with your number: scammers do this on purpose to lock the owner out. Do not tell anyone codes from SMS or Telegram. When the time is up, sign in and turn on two-step verification right away.
